description: Get EU/international legal basis (directives, regulations, conventions) that influenced a South African statute. Returns all international instruments that the SA statute was modeled on or aligned with. Example: POPIA -> influenced by GDPR (Regulation 2016/679). Example: Cybercrimes Act -> aligned with Budapest Convention on Cybercrime.

document_id.description: SA statute identifier (e.g., "act-4-2013") or title (e.g., "Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013")

include_articles.description: Include specific article references in the response (default: false)

reference_types.description: Filter by reference type. Omit to return all types.

name: get_eu_basis
